module.title: Add HBW-MB module
module.description: Modbus gateway (e.g. Waveshare RS485 TO ETH in Modbus TCP to RTU mode) and the module's Modbus ID.

data.name: Name (empty = HBWMB_A + Modbus ID, counters from ID 21: HBWMB_S01 …)

bus.title: Add bus
bus.description: Gateway the modules are connected to. The bus gets the buttons “Search for new module” and “Scan bus”. It does not poll anything on its own.

bus_confirm.title: Add bus?
bus_confirm.description: HBW-MB modules are connected to gateway {host}. The bus device lets you search for new modules at the push of a button; without that it does not poll anything.

discovery_confirm.title: Module found
discovery_confirm.description: {model} at Modbus ID {unit}, firmware {firmware}, HBW address {hbw_address}. Add it?

assign_id.title: New module: assign ID
assign_id.description: {model}, firmware {firmware}, HBW address {hbw_address}, still answers at service ID 247. The new ID is written to the module and saved there. Suggested is the next free ID (switch/blind modules 1–19, counters 21–29).

data.name: Name (empty = HBWMB_A + Modbus ID, counters: HBWMB_S01 …)

error.cannot_connect: The module does not answer. Check gateway, port and Modbus ID.
error.id_configured: This ID is already configured in HA for another module.
error.id_in_use: A device on the bus already answers at this ID.
error.no_answer: The module did not answer when writing the ID. Is it still connected?
error.assign_failed: The ID was written, but the module does not answer at the new ID.
error.id_range: Switch and blind modules use IDs 1–19, counters 21–29.

abort.already_in_progress: A confirmation for this module is already pending.

turn_on_for.name: Turn on for
turn_on_for.description: Turn the channel on; the module turns it off by itself after the given time (like on-for-timer).

set_meter_reading.name: Set meter reading
set_meter_reading.description: Set the meter reading of an S0 input in kWh, e.g. to match the real meter. Saved in the module immediately.

init.title: Counter module
init.description: Applies to all inputs. Pulses per kWh are printed on the meter (e.g. 1000 imp/kWh). Power below the minimum is shown as 0 W: with 1 Wh per pulse, low power only becomes visible after many minutes; with 10 W the value drops to 0 six minutes after the last pulse. The meter reading always counts everything.

module_offline.title: {module} does not respond
module_offline.description: The module {module} has not answered on the bus since {since}. Check power, bus wiring and the gateway. This message disappears as soon as the module answers again.

bus_errors.title: Bus errors at {module}
bus_errors.description: {module} received {count} corrupted telegrams (CRC errors) within the last hour. Check termination, wiring and interference. This message disappears after a quiet hour.
